review.algorithm_assessment: The triangular AND exercise sums all subarray ANDs. For each bit, contribution counts all-one subarrays. Flipping at p creates/removes (p-left_zero)*(right_zero-p) qualifying subarrays. Fenwick order statistics over zero positions find nearest barriers; only changed bits update. Compact arrays use O(17n) storage, O(17 log n) per mutation.
